style: Glassmorphism brand sting on a deep violet aurora: split frame — brand column (3D glass envelope logo, 'Follow-up' wordmark, MANAGER, loading bar + counters) and a glass Outlook inbox panel where fictitious emails stream upward ever faster and get their status as they cross a glowing sort line. No light beams, no sparkles.

customize.pieces: glass tile, envelope body, folding flap, badge, drawn check
customize.loader: progress bar + '% / emails analysés / suivis créés' counters synced to the stream
customize.stream: 30 fictitious emails, accelerating conveyor, chip swap Nouveau → Suivi créé / Relance / En attente / Terminé at the sort line
customize.resolve: panel exits, brand column centres, status flips to 'Tout est à jour'

content.logo: hand-built vector (SVG + CSS 3D) recreating the user's glass envelope icon

brief: The logo assembles in 3D and the wordmark rises while an Outlook inbox panel slides in. Fictitious emails stream through it faster and faster; each one is sorted as it crosses a glowing line while the loading bar and counters climb to 100 % / 248 emails / 37 suivis. The inbox leaves, the brand settles at centre with 'Tout est à jour', ready for the app to crossfade in. Dominant motif: mail handled at speed.
